title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: base premium on the value a cover was bound for
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the base premium from which the premium charged on a bound cover is built up.

## Rule

1. The premium charged on a bound cover is built up on the Insured Value the cover was bound for.
2. First, that Insured Value is multiplied by the product's premium rate percent, giving the base premium.
3. The base premium is not rounded at this step.

## Hypothetical worked examples

All figures are hypothetical; a rate of 0.2 percent is used only to show the working.

| Insured Value bound | Rate | Base premium |
|---|---|---|
| 250,000.00 USD | 0.2 percent | 500.00 |
| 123,456.78 USD | 0.2 percent | 246.91356 (kept unrounded) |

## Points of judgement

**The quote showed a different value from the value bound. Which one is used?** The Insured Value the cover was bound for.
